goal: Let RPC callers optionally receive fee rates in sat/vB instead of BTC/kvB
Prevent client conversion friction and sub-1 sat/vB rounding errors for wallet integrations
agreement: Strong support for backwards-compatible sat/vB output (musaHaruna, w0xlt)
Open suggestion to add release notes for positional argument changes (willcl-ark)
Past objections regarding float precision and maintaining default units are resolved (maflcko, glozow)

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because it improves caller ergonomics by matching common wallet fee units without breaking defaults
Impact is limited to callers who explicitly opt in to the new parameter
